verses.text: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.

segments.text: I love Jehovah, because he heareth
My voice and my supplications.

verses.text: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

segments.text: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me,
Therefore will I call
upon him
as long as I live.

verses.text: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

segments.text: The cords of death compassed me,
And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me:
I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.text: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

segments.text: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah:
O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

verses.text: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.

segments.text: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous;
Yea, our God is merciful.

verses.text: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.

segments.text: Jehovah preserveth the simple:
I was brought low, and he saved me.

verses.text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.

segments.text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul;
For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from falling.

segments.text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death,
Mine eyes from tears,
And
my feet from falling.

verses.text: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.

segments.text: I will walk before Jehovah
In the land of the living.

verses.text: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:

segments.text: I believe, for I will speak:
I was greatly afflicted:

verses.text: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

segments.text: I said in my haste,
All men are liars.

verses.text: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?

segments.text: What shall I render unto Jehovah
For all his benefits toward me?

verses.text: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.

segments.text: I will take the cup of salvation,
And call upon the name of Jehovah.

verses.text: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.

segments.text: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah,
Yea, in the presence of all his people.

verses.text: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.

segments.text: Precious in the sight of Jehovah
Is the death of his saints.

verses.text: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.

segments.text: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant:

verses.text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.

segments.text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving,

segments.text: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah,

verses.text: In the courts of Jehovah’s house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
